race.description: Thoroughbred Park Event Centre Mdn Plate
race.comment: NO REMORSE (3) comes through a nice trial at Randwick recently and lines up here on debut, with the booking of Loy a good push for his chances. He'll need some luck from the draw, but he's shown enough in his public outings and the names he's trialled around stand out. MONTE SHELL (10) has been sound in two runs to date at provincial level and should find this slightly easier. Her racing pattern is ideal for the Acton course4 and she comes here on the fresh side. Can land the knockout blow without surprising. THREE WISHES (8) gets the blinkers on for the first time today after a 1.6L defeat over this track and trip last time. Guymer now hops on board and she should be nearing her peak third-up. Can make her presence felt. NOTHING SPECIAL (4) is now with the Potter stable and was sound on resumption. Can feature. XCEPTIONAL SPIRIT (11) won't be far away first-up.
